result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # zero rectangle is the destination
    zs=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0]
    if not zs: return g
    r0=min(i for i,j in zs); r1=max(i for i,j in zs)
    c0=min(j for i,j in zs); c1=max(j for i,j in zs)
    hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
    bg=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in g))
    # locate the non-background rectangular object of matching size
    best=None
    for i in range(h-hh+1):
      for j in range(w-ww+1):
        if i>=r0 and i<=r1: continue
        block=[g[i+u][j:j+ww] for u in range(hh)]
        if all(x!=bg and x!=0 for row in block for x in row):
          best=(i,j); break
      if best: break
    if best is None: return g
    i,j=best
    for u in range(hh):
      for v in range(ww): g[r0+u][c0+v]=g[i+u][j+ww-1-v]
    return g"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # locate rectangular zero target
    z=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0]
    zr0=min(i for i,j in z); zr1=max(i for i,j in z)
    zc0=min(j for i,j in z); zc1=max(j for i,j in z)
    # locate non-background colored source (exclude 0 and 1)
    p=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,1)]
    r0=min(i for i,j in p); r1=max(i for i,j in p)
    c0=min(j for i,j in p); c1=max(j for i,j in p)
    for i in range(zr0,zr1+1):
        si=r0+(i-zr0)
        for j in range(zc0,zc1+1):
            sj=c1-(j-zc0)
            g[i][j]=g[si][sj]
    return g"}
